motions.topic: Bypass the llama.cpp mmproj load bug by building the image/audio index OFFLINE with a Python EmbeddingGemma 2 multimodal encoder (sentence-transformers / transformers with the vision+audio config), appending those 768-dim vectors to the SAME semantic index the Rust runtime already scans. Python is used only as offline ingestion tooling (the same as the existing build_semantic_index.py); the runtime recall stays Rust. The mmproj server path remains wired but deferred until a llama.cpp build loads it. The TEST is pre-registered: image and audio vectors are appended to the index, and a TEXT query retrieves the matching image/audio document cross-modally (a picture of a cat retrieves via 'a cat' and vice versa), with every vector labeled measured_on_host (produced by the offline encoder), no fabricated figure. READ FROM SOURCE (this host): llama-server b11856 AND b11457 both fail to load mmproj-embeddinggemma-2-Q8_0.gguf with the identical 'clip_init: failed to load model ... load_tensors: failed to seek for tensor v.blk.0.attn_k.weight' (a tensor-offset read failure), so it is NOT a build regression. The mmproj file is 554,696,704 bytes (matches the HF-listed 529 MB) with a valid GGUF v3 header (963 tensors, 30 kv). The reporter's working case used the matching text model embeddinggemma-2-Q8_0.gguf; this host runs the 'UD' variant embeddinggemma-2-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf (175 MB), which is text-verified (cat-feline 0.96) but is a DIFFERENT conversion. huggingface.co now rate-limits this host (ConnectionResetError on /api/models and /resolve), so a clean re-download is blocked for now. The Rust interface is already multimodal-ready: intelligence_router::embed_media + semantic_recall::lookup_media + POST /recall/semantic/media, all fail-closed. REJECT AS PREMATURE if the media vectors are appended WITHOUT a cross-modal retrieval check (same-space claim must be proven by retrieval, not asserted), or if any runtime recall path is moved into Python (ingestion may be Python; the live recall stays Rust).
